svg.title: Operate the Domain Inventory-to-Cash Loop
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-domain-inventory-to-cash; chart type: process_flow; title: Operate the Domain Inventory-to-Cash Loop; subtitle: Five controlled handoffs from sourcing to renewal or exit.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The core pod is one full-time owner plus one contractor. First-deal timing is 3–24 months; a completed sourcing cycle does not establish buyer demand or immediate liquidity.; caption: Recognized operator revenue is gross domain sale proceeds. Escrow balances awaiting release and unsold asking prices are not completed-sale revenue.; stages: label: Source; value: Build a comparable-backed candidate queue; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Monitor NameBio comparables, expired-name lists, and drop-catch auctions; record extension, sale date, venue, buyer use case, and maximum bid.; label: Screen; value: Document rights and historical-use checks; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Use USPTO Trademark Search, ICANN Lookup, RDAP, and Wayback Machine records; reject mark-targeting theses and investigate conflicting historical use.; label: Acquire; value: Cap bids against total carrying exposure; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Include auction fees, transfer charges, premium renewals, and expected holding periods in the bid ceiling; record registrar access and ownership evidence.; label: Market; value: Route inquiries into a priced negotiation; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Publish consistent marketplace and landing-page prices; route inquiries to one owner and record buyer identity, offer history, and net settlement math.; label: Settle and recycle; value: Verify payment, transfer, and renewal decisions; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Verify escrow instructions independently, follow registrar transfer procedures, reconcile released proceeds, and reassess unsold names before renewal.

circle.title: label: Source; value: Build a comparable-backed candidate queue; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Monitor NameBio comparables, expired-name lists, and drop-catch auctions; record extension, sale date, venue, buyer use case, and maximum bid.

text.title: Monitor NameBio comparables, expired-name lists, and drop-catch auctions; record extension, sale date, venue, buyer use case, and maximum bid.

circle.title: label: Screen; value: Document rights and historical-use checks; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Use USPTO Trademark Search, ICANN Lookup, RDAP, and Wayback Machine records; reject mark-targeting theses and investigate conflicting historical use.

text.title: Use USPTO Trademark Search, ICANN Lookup, RDAP, and Wayback Machine records; reject mark-targeting theses and investigate conflicting historical use.

circle.title: label: Acquire; value: Cap bids against total carrying exposure; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Include auction fees, transfer charges, premium renewals, and expected holding periods in the bid ceiling; record registrar access and ownership evidence.

text.title: Include auction fees, transfer charges, premium renewals, and expected holding periods in the bid ceiling; record registrar access and ownership evidence.

circle.title: label: Market; value: Route inquiries into a priced negotiation; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Publish consistent marketplace and landing-page prices; route inquiries to one owner and record buyer identity, offer history, and net settlement math.

text.title: Publish consistent marketplace and landing-page prices; route inquiries to one owner and record buyer identity, offer history, and net settlement math.

circle.title: label: Settle and recycle; value: Verify payment, transfer, and renewal decisions; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Verify escrow instructions independently, follow registrar transfer procedures, reconcile released proceeds, and reassess unsold names before renewal.

text.title: Verify escrow instructions independently, follow registrar transfer procedures, reconcile released proceeds, and reassess unsold names before renewal.
Assumptions: The core pod is one full-time owner plus one contractor. First-deal timing is 3–24 months; a completed sourcing cycle does not establish buyer demand or immediate liquidity.

does not establish buyer demand or immediate liquidity.
